item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera's teacher in Jaipur asks why India has summer in June while her pen-friend in Australia has winter at the same time. Which statement gives the correct reason?

options.A: In June the Earth is closer to the Sun, so the Northern Hemisphere becomes warmer.
options.B: Earth's axis stays tilted in the same direction as Earth revolves around the Sun, so in June the Northern Hemisphere receives more direct sunlight and longer days.
options.C: The Sun gives out more heat in June, so countries near the equator become hotter.
options.D: The Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere both have summer in June because Earth spins on its axis.
